title: queue action
description: Sends a copy to a named queue. Durable queues require enqueue delivery; memory queues may wait for processing.

path.description: Logical queue name from queue:<name>; alternative to targetQueueId

delivery.description: processed waits for the consumer; enqueue returns after buffering

targetQueueId.title: Target queue
targetQueueId.description: Logical queue name; defaults to the receiver flow id in legacy flows

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Broker of the Java platform, such as activemq; informational only, as queues are in memory

exchangePattern.title: Exchange pattern
exchangePattern.description: InOut: the target flow's outcome replaces the message; InOnly: the message passes on unchanged

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout
requestTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the target flow

requestTimout.title: Request timeout (misspelled)
requestTimout.description: Same as requestTimeout, as the designer writes it; it wins when both are set

overflow.description: Admission policy when the channel is full

enqueueTimeout.description: Admission timeout in milliseconds; positive value required with overflow block
